name: Shopping List
description: Items mentioned, grouped by where you would find them.
outline: List every item that was mentioned as a '- [ ] ' checkbox with the quantity if given.
Group the items under store-section headings such as Produce, Dairy, Bakery, Household.
Merge duplicates and keep the language of the speaker.
Put non-shopping errands that were mentioned in a separate Errands list.
Do not add items that were not said.
example:
## Produce
- [ ] 6 apples
- [ ] spinach

## Dairy
- [ ] oat milk
